metadata.name: UK Legal Data Agent Routing Extension
metadata.description: Optional 3-question extension for USER_GUIDE.md Step 5 (derived Lakehouse tables and routing). Run alongside hackathon_challenge_dataset.json; do not merge into the six-question scored challenge.
metadata.source_data_version: step6 CSV files generated by step6/generate_step6_data.py

evaluation_queries.question: Which customers are in the low engagement segment?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_answer: See step6_client_engagement_summary rows where engagement_segment = 'Low Engagement'
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM step6_client_engagement_summary WHERE engagement_segment = 'Low Engagement' ORDER BY customer_name
evaluation_queries.notes: Only the step6_client_engagement_summary Lakehouse table has this classification; LegalFirmOptimized does not.

evaluation_queries.question: Which high-value open cases have outstanding balances?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_answer: See step6_case_finance_insights rows where case_status = 'Open', case_value_gbp >= 100000, and outstanding_amount_gbp > 0
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT case_id, solicitor_name, case_value_gbp, outstanding_amount_gbp FROM step6_case_finance_insights WHERE case_status = 'Open' AND case_value_gbp >= 100000 AND outstanding_amount_gbp > 0 ORDER BY outstanding_amount_gbp DESC
evaluation_queries.notes: Combines case status, value, and outstanding balance; only available pre-joined in step6_case_finance_insights.

evaluation_queries.question: Which solicitors are in the top performance tier?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT solicitor_name, cases_handled, total_case_value_gbp FROM step6_solicitor_performance_mart WHERE performance_tier = 'Top' ORDER BY total_case_value_gbp DESC
